QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] More Allies
QuestInfo.0: I feel better knowing we're not alone in our fight against the Black Mage. I only hope #p1013000# feels the same.
QuestInfo.1: #p1013000# is excited about the turn of events. With enough help, the Black Mage and his Black Wings won't stand a chance!
QuestInfo.2: Will you escort me to the continental conference?

0.0: A continental conference?! And they want me to come?! That's so cool! I hope you don't feel overwhelmed when you meet all those important and powerful warriors. And don't feel bad if everybody's asking for my autograph, okay? We're going to make so many friends and beat up that stupid Black Mage!

1.0: I'm glad. I feel relieved to know you'll be on our side.
